post.caption:
Claude now ships Sheets, Whiteboards, Data and Meetings, pushing Anthropic into office-suite territory. 📊

Today's stories:

1. Anthropic adds Sheets, Whiteboards, Data and Meetings to Claude; Barron's reports Microsoft stock fell on the news. (The Verge)
2. The Nvidia CEO espionage scandal raises the odds Congress passes AI chip export limits through the defence bill. (Nvidia)
3. Microsoft Research shows a backdoor that edits dormant neurons in AI agents, letting a triggered agent run attacker code. (Microsoft Research)
4. Grok Build's shareable links exposed data from about 35,000 apps, including proprietary business information and secrets. (Ars Technica)
5. Anthropic kicks off its IPO roadshow at $70 to $78 per share, a range reporters call below earlier expectations. (The Decoder)
6. Gemini Robotics 2.5 reported 96 percent success sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot. (Google DeepMind)
7. OpenAI opens Business profiles and verified Business Agents in ChatGPT for eligible US e-commerce businesses. (OpenAI)
8. AlphaProof Code agents wrote three million lines of Lean proofs verifying Signal's encryption core. (Google DeepMind)
9. Meta launches Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model, aimed at agent workloads. (Simon Willison)

Two security stories about agents today: check what yours can reach.
